description: This file defines the NonMonotonicSequenceException class, an exception used in the Apache Commons Math library to signal when a sequence of numbers is not monotonically increasing or decreasing, with options for strictness and direction.

classes.name: NonMonotonicSequenceException
classes.description: An exception class indicating a sequence is not monotonic as expected, with details about the direction, strictness, index, and previous value.

methods.name: NonMonotonicSequenceException
methods.description: Constructor with specified direction and strictness.

methods.name: getDirection
methods.description: Returns the direction of the sequence (increasing or decreasing).

methods.name: getStrict
methods.description: Returns whether the sequence must be strictly monotonic.

methods.name: getIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the value that violates the sequence.

methods.name: getPrevious
methods.description: Returns the previous value in the sequence.
